members.name: open
members.description: The controlled open state of the color panel, used with `v-model:open`.

members.name: size
members.description: The size of the trigger and color controls.

members.name: modelValue
members.description: The current color string; `null` means no color is selected. Supports two-way binding with `v-model`.

members.name: format
members.description: The input and output color format: HEX, RGB, or HSL.

members.name: showAlpha
members.description: Shows the opacity slider and includes the alpha channel in emitted color values.

members.name: presets

references.name: ColorPreset

members.description: Optional swatches as color strings or `ColorPreset` objects with labels and disabled states. The panel uses its built-in presets when omitted.

members.name: showPresets
members.description: Controls whether the panel displays preset swatches.

members.name: presetsLabel
members.description: The visible heading for the preset area; localized text is used when omitted.

members.name: showHistory
members.description: Controls whether the panel displays and maintains recently selected colors.

members.name: historyMax
members.description: The maximum number of entries retained in color history.

members.name: historyStorageKey
members.description: The `localStorage` key used to persist color history.

members.name: showInput
members.description: Shows the color text in the trigger. When false, the trigger shows the swatch and placeholder only.

members.name: placeholder
members.description: Placeholder text shown when there is no valid color; it is also the localized fallback for the accessible name.

members.name: disabled
members.description: Disables the trigger and clear action and prevents opening the color panel.

members.name: clearable
members.description: Shows a clear button when a color is selected and the control is enabled.

members.name: name
members.description: The form field name. When set, a hidden input submits the current color; a disabled control is excluded from form submission.

members.name: id
members.description: Sets the native HTML `id` on the trigger button.

members.name: ariaLabel
members.description: The accessible name of the trigger; localized placeholder text is used when omitted.

members.name: class
members.description: CSS classes added to the color picker trigger. Supports array and object forms accepted by `ClassValue`.

members.name: update:modelValue
members.description: Emits the formatted color as it is typed, selected by dragging, or cleared; clearing emits `null`.

members.name: open
members.description: Emitted without a payload when the panel opens.

members.name: close
members.description: Emitted without a payload when the panel closes.

members.name: update:open
members.description: Emits the new boolean open state so a controlled `open` value can be updated.

members.name: change
members.description: Emits the final value when the user confirms or clears a color, separate from intermediate `update:modelValue` changes.

members.name: open
members.description: A `Ref` for the panel open state. Read or write it through the component instance to open or close the panel programmatically.

members.name: history
members.description: The list of historical color strings to display; invalid colors are filtered out.

members.name: modelValue
members.description: The current color, used to highlight a swatch with the same normalized color value.

members.name: size
members.description: The size of the history swatches.

members.name: ariaLabel
members.description: The accessible name of the history group; a localized heading is used when omitted.

members.name: clearLabel
members.description: The accessible name of the clear-history button; localized text is used when omitted.

members.name: clear
members.description: Emitted without a payload when the user activates the clear button.

members.name: select
members.description: Emits the color string when the user selects a valid history swatch.

members.name: modelValue
members.description: The current color. Valid values are displayed in the requested `format`; `null` leaves the input empty.

members.name: format
members.description: The format used to normalize and emit the input value.

members.name: showAlpha
members.description: Whether formatted color values include the alpha channel.

members.name: disabled
members.description: Disables the native text input.

members.name: ariaLabel
members.description: The accessible name of the text input.

members.name: update:modelValue
members.description: Emitted when the input is empty or contains a valid color; invalid text does not update the color value.

members.name: confirm
members.description: Confirms a valid color or empty value on Enter or blur; invalid text is restored from the current model value.

members.name: modelValue
members.description: The panel current color; `null` means no color is selected.

members.name: format
members.description: The color format used when the panel creates and formats color values.

members.name: showAlpha
members.description: Shows the opacity control and includes the alpha channel in color values.

members.name: presets

references.name: ColorPreset

members.description: Swatches as strings or `ColorPreset` objects. The built-in palette is used when omitted.

members.name: showPresets
members.description: Whether to render the preset swatches section.

members.name: presetsLabel
members.description: The preset-section heading; localized text is used when omitted.

members.name: showHistory
members.description: Whether to display the color history section.

members.name: historyMax
members.description: The maximum number of colors retained in history.

members.name: historyStorageKey
members.description: The `localStorage` key passed to the color-history storage logic.

members.name: showInput
members.description: Whether to show the editable color text input.

members.name: clearable
members.description: Whether to show the action for clearing the current color.

members.name: size
members.description: The size of the panel swatches and controls.

members.name: update:modelValue
members.description: Emits the new value when a panel control changes the color.

members.name: clear
members.description: Emitted without a payload when the user clears the current color.

members.name: confirm
members.description: Emits the final color value when the user confirms the panel selection.

members.name: value
members.description: The color string represented by the swatch; invalid colors disable the button.

members.name: label
members.description: The swatch tooltip and fallback accessible name.

members.name: selected
members.description: Whether the swatch is selected, also reflected by `aria-pressed`.

members.name: disabled
members.description: Disables mouse and keyboard selection of the swatch.

members.name: size
members.description: The size of the swatch button.

members.name: ariaLabel
members.description: Explicitly sets the swatch button accessible name, taking precedence over `label` and the color value.

members.name: select
members.description: Emits the color string when a valid, enabled swatch is activated.
